additions.name: Highreso Ayagawa Existing Operations

status.summary: The dated operator article explicitly describes Highreso as currently operating the Ayagawa facility. September 17 is confirmation publication, not opening. The article separately reports a September 2 inside-facility visit and a March 2026 opening month.

locator.precision: Reference point from the OpenStreetMap bounding box of the named former Ayakami Junior High School campus, used only as a parent-property locator. It is not an operator-published DC pin, surveyed centroid, official property boundary, data-center building location or under-gym footprint. Source coordinate digits do not establish ground accuracy.
locator.identity_review: The prefecture identifies Ayagawa DC in the former Ayakami Junior High School at Yamada-kami Ko 1180; the municipal reuse page and PDF independently bind the same school/address. OSM way 1166115347 names that former school and is distinct from nearby Ayakami Elementary School. The municipal plan matches the GSI aerial compound through its long central classrooms, northern annex, southeast gym, southwest pool, northeast sports field, and curved west/south access road. No current DC floor or boundary is derived.
locator.uncertainty_reason: OSM feature geometry and its bounding-box reference point have no selected numeric positional-accuracy statement. Historical campus layout and source coordinate precision do not establish DC building accuracy.

additions.distinctness_review: Tenth baseline 413 sites, 439 projects and 231 source records reviewed. No Ayagawa, 綾川, Ayakami or 綾上 identity match. Existing Highreso Takamatsu is a different former research facility and is the nearest site at approximately 12.602 km. Genkai former school is also separate. Root and a separate reviewer independently verified the school identity, mapped point and campus-only precision.
additions.successor_review: Current operating assertion is selected independently of the historical planned opening ceremony. Separate classroom community-space plans are not treated as delivered DC capacity. The operator article contains unrelated Wednesday labels for February 28 and August 2 community events, which conflict with calendar weekdays; preserve this caveat and exclude them from status evidence.
